Container.Name: MegaDL
Container.Overview: Download mega.nz file and folder links to your array from a web GUI. Sign in to your MEGA account to use its transfer quota, pick the destination folder for each download, pause, resume or remove downloads, and limit download speed. Uses MEGAcmd, MEGA's official command-line client.

Config.Name: Web GUI port
Config.Description: Port for the MegaDL web interface.

Config.Name: Downloads root
Config.Description: The part of your server MegaDL can browse and save into. /mnt/user/ lets you pick any share from the GUI. Use a single share (for example /mnt/user/downloads/) to restrict it.

Config.Name: Default download folder
Config.Description: Folder inside the downloads root used when you don't pick one. Created if missing. You can change it later in the GUI's Settings.

Config.Name: Web GUI password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the browser asks for a user name and this password before showing MegaDL.

Config.Name: Web GUI user name
Config.Description: User name for the web GUI password prompt.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Download list, settings, logs and the MEGA session. If MEGAcmd fails to start, try /mnt/cache/appdata/megadl.

Config.Name: Host path label
Config.Description: Only for display: set to the same host path as Downloads root so the GUI shows real server paths.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns downloaded files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns downloaded files (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: umask for files the app creates.

Config.Name: File permissions
Config.Description: Permissions MEGAcmd gives downloaded files. MEGAcmd's own default (600) would hide them from SMB users.

Config.Name: Folder permissions
Config.Description: Permissions MEGAcmd gives folders it creates.
